The winners are assured a place in the [[2027–28 UEFA Europa League#Group stage|2027–28 UEFA Europa League group stage]]. Both the winners and the runners-up will qualify for the four-team [[2028 Supercopa de España]]. [[Real Sociedad]] are the defending champions, having beaten [[Atlético Madrid]] in the [[2026 Copa del Rey final|final of the previous edition]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401859852|title=Real Sociedad upset Atlético Madrid to win 4th Copa del Rey|website=ESPN|date=18 April 2026|access-date=14 May 2026}} The final will be held at [[Estadio de La Cartuja|La Cartuja]] in [[Seville]] in April 2027. As across Spain, match times up to 25 October 2026 and from 29 March 2027 are [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]). Times on interim ("winter") days are [[Central European Time|CET]] ([[UTC+01:00|UTC+1]]).
